subject: Advance deposit price protection — FinCo renewal
messages:
From: Elena Morse <elena.morse@finco.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: looking at multi-year advance deposit option

Diego —

Thanks again for the renewal summary. We saw the standard renewal numbers and wanted to explore whether Redwood can offer a multi-year advance deposit to lock current unit rates for the next 24 months. A couple of constraints on our side:

- We need to avoid a material step-up at the start of the next fiscal year.
- We can commit to a 2-year term but need a ramped deposit schedule (not a single up-front payment).
- Our procurement requires a simple schedule and an explicit price protection guarantee for the deposited capacity.

Can you share possible structures (term sheet, deposit schedule, sample contract language) and any impacts on discounts or service credits? Ideally want to finalize by the end of January.

Attached is our RFQ and the list of expected monthly consumption growth.

—Elena
Elena Morse
Head of Platform Procurement
FinCo, Inc.
attn: procurement@finco.com

Attachment: RFQ-FinCo-Deposit-Terms.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morse <elena.morse@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: looking at multi-year advance deposit option

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the RFQ. Quick read-through: a 2-year ramped advance deposit is something we can support. High level proposal attached ("advance-deposit-term-sheet.xlsx"). Key bullets:

- Price protection: lock current hosted rates for 24 months for the capacity covered by the deposit.
- Discounting: blended discount up to 12% on committed spend, tiered by effective annual commitment.
- Ramp schedule: 30% at signing, 40% at month 6, 30% at month 12 (example — we can adjust to suit procurement).
- Usage true-up: monthly reconciliation with credits for unused committed capacity applied to subsequent months.
- SLA/credits: standard Redwood Dedicated SLA applies; deposit-backed credits for systemic outages > 6 hours.

Two asks from my side to move fast:
1) Can procurement accept a staged deposit vs. a single prepay?
2) Any internal approval gates we should loop in on the HubSpot deal (deal id DL-2027-0921)?

If that looks directionally good, I can schedule a short call Monday to run through the term sheet and lock a DocuSign for the deposit schedule.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: advance-deposit-term-sheet.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: FinCo advance-deposit — recommended concession/structure

Team —

Quick summary from the external thread (Elena) and my recommended commercial:

Summary: FinCo wants a 2-year advance deposit with a ramped payment schedule to lock hosted unit pricing and avoid a rate step-up at the start of the next fiscal year. They supplied expected growth numbers in the RFQ.

Recommended terms (for approval):
- Term: 24 months.
- Commit: $1.8M total committed capacity (based on their forecast).
- Discount: 10% year-1 effective discount on committed units, 6% year-2 (blended benefit vs. list).
- Deposit schedule: 25% signing, 35% at 90 days, 40% at 270 days (matches their finance calendar).
- True-up: monthly usage reconciliation with credits to the next billing cycle.

Rationale: preserves revenue predictability, keeps list price protected for them, and avoids immediate cash-hit by staggering payments. Concession ask is small vs. multi-year retention value.

Questions for you:
- Vivek: ok to approve a 10% first-year concession for DL-2027-0921?
- Marissa: will Finance accept the 25/35/40 schedule and escrow-style bookkeeping?
- Rishi: any compliance/risk concerns about deposit-backed credits in contract language?

I propose to offer the attached term-sheet as-is and push for a DocuSign next week if we get a greenlight.

Thanks,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morse <elena.morse@finco.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Advance deposit price protection — FinCo renewal

Diego / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the term sheet. After an internal run with procurement and finance, FinCo is prepared to accept the 24-month advance deposit with the 25/35/40 ramp schedule and the proposed discount profile pending standard contract language and proof of price guarantee in the schedule. Two small asks before we sign:

1) Include explicit language in the contract that the unit price for committed capacity will not increase during the 24-month term.
2) Provide a sample invoice flow that shows how monthly true-ups and credits will be applied to subsequent invoices.

If you can send the DocuSign with the updated language and the sample invoice schedule, procurement will sign and we can wire the first tranche within 10 business days.

Please send the updated doc and a DocuSign link to procurement@finco.com.

—Elena
Elena Morse
Head of Platform Procurement
FinCo, Inc.
